title: Pile-installation vibration and snow-shadow concerns beside six-storey apartment (Council Order 2021-07)

facts.text: The appeal concerned a cancelled permit and whether the submitted information addressed adjacent-property impacts from pile-installation vibration and snow shadow.
The proposed project was described as a six-storey apartment building; the adjacent building was reported to be about 3 m away.

The Council order describes the professional letter as unauthenticated and not sufficiently site-specific; it lacked considered factors, relevant calculations, adjacent-building information and specific code references.

limitations: Underlying permit drawings, engineer letter and exhibits are referenced but not attached separately.
